legend: An intralobar nephrogenic rest, rich in stroma and with small cysts, blending with the surrounding renal parenchyma.

diagnosis: WAGR syndrome (Wilms tumour, aniridia, genitourinary anomalies, and a range of developmental delays)
legend: Greyscale ultrasound of a patient with WAGR syndrome shows a fairly well-circumscribed hypoechoic mass in the middle region of the left kidney, which was subsequently confirmed to be a Wilms tumour.
